tokens.notes: Reference tokenizer counts of saved texts/artifacts, not actual model billing. Standalone inputs repeat the prompt per plant. Batch file counts and once-per-batch prompts omit system/tool context, repeated reads and reasoning. Observed generation-agent usage is separately recorded in agent-usage.json; it is not subscription billing. Field contributions are the change in compact tokens on removing that field group, not extra LLM inference measurements.

timing.notes: Agent-recorded first-tool to output-completion times; up to three concurrent batches. Includes reading, writing and validation, not pure inference latency. Wall interval includes dispatch gaps.
